title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #18 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who tried to run away from God's task? (1 mark)
   A. Daniel
   B. Joseph
   C. Jonah
   D. Stephen

2. Which verse tells children to obey parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Ephesians 6:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Genesis 12:1

3. Which action shows love? (1 mark)
   A. Teasing
   B. Ignoring
   C. Hurting
   D. Sharing your lunch

4. How can we show love for God? (1 mark)
   A. By ignoring them
   B. By being rude
   C. By being greedy
   D. By obeying His teachings

5. Which is school property? (1 mark)
   A. Your lunch
   B. Your shoes
   C. A desk
   D. A pencil case

6. Which action shows care for school property? (1 mark)
   A. Writing on desks
   B. Keeping toilets clean
   C. Breaking chairs
   D. Wasting water

7. Who does the Bible say we should be like in holiness? (1 mark)
   A. Our teachers
   B. God
   C. Our friends
   D. The king

8. Why did Jesus drive out the buyers and sellers? (1 mark)
   A. They were poor
   B. They were children
   C. They were noisy
   D. They were misusing God's house

9. Which verse mentions activities such as a hymn and a word of instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. John 3:16
   C. 1 Corinthians 14:26
   D. Genesis 1:1

10. What came upon the disciples at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. An army
   B. The Holy Spirit
   C. A storm only
   D. A king

11. What does Acts 2:38 tell people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Repent and be baptised
   B. Sell everything
   C. Stay at home
   D. Fast for a month

12. What does the word Christian mean? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. A rich person
   C. A priest
   D. A follower of Christ

13. What did Stephen pray for those stoning him? (1 mark)
   A. Take me away
   B. Lord, do not hold this sin against them
   C. Punish them
   D. Send fire

14. In Matthew 6:5-6, how did Jesus say we should pray? (1 mark)
   A. Loudly to impress
   B. Never
   C. Sincerely, not to be seen by others
   D. Only in public

15. Which verses list the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Galatians 5:22-23
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. John 3:16

16. Why does the Bible say "fruit" and not "fruits"? (1 mark)
   A. It is a mistake
   B. There is only one
   C. The qualities belong together
   D. It refers to mangoes

17. Who helps us to make right decisions? (1 mark)
   A. Bad friends
   B. The Holy Spirit
   C. Nobody
   D. Strangers

18. Which of these can harm the body? (1 mark)
   A. Clean water
   B. Drugs
   C. Fruit
   D. Rest

19. What is social media? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. A newspaper
   C. Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   D. A school

20. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Sending hurtful messages to others
   B. Sharing kind words
   C. Watching a lesson
   D. Praying online

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give two people you should pray for. (2 marks)

22. State three ways in which the first Christians lived together. (3 marks)

23. Describe four steps of how to pray. (4 marks)

24. Explain what it means to say that love is a choice. (4 marks)

25. Give three ways of avoiding situations that lead to sin. (3 marks)

26. Write the first two lines of the Lord's Prayer. (2 marks)

27. Describe four dangers of misusing social media. (4 marks)

28. List six of the twelve disciples. (3 marks)

29. Explain how a child can show any five fruits of the Spirit in daily life. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Jonah
   Jonah ran away before he obeyed.

2. B — Ephesians 6:1
   Ephesians 6:1 says this.

3. D — Sharing your lunch
   Sharing is practical love.

4. D — By obeying His teachings
   Jesus said love shows in obedience.

5. C — A desk
   A desk belongs to the school.

6. B — Keeping toilets clean
   Cleanliness respects property.

7. B — God
   1 Peter 1:16 says to be holy because God is holy.

8. D — They were misusing God's house
   The temple was for prayer, not trading.

9. C — 1 Corinthians 14:26
   1 Corinthians 14:26 lists activities in worship.

10. B — The Holy Spirit
   Acts 2 tells of the Holy Spirit.

11. A — Repent and be baptised
   Peter's answer to the crowd.

12. D — A follower of Christ
   Christian means a follower of Christ.

13. B — Lord, do not hold this sin against them
   Acts 7:60.

14. C — Sincerely, not to be seen by others
   Jesus warned against showing off.

15. A — Galatians 5:22-23
   Galatians 5:22-23.

16. C — The qualities belong together
   The nine qualities are one fruit.

17. B — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit guides believers.

18. B — Drugs
   Drugs harm the body and mind.

19. C — Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   Social media lets people connect.

20. A — Sending hurtful messages to others
   Bullying can happen online.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parents, guardians, friends, teachers, sick people, leaders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: They learned the teaching, prayed, ate together, shared with the needy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a quiet moment, speak with respect, thank Him, say sorry, ask for help, say Amen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: We do not always feel like loving. We can still choose to be kind, like helping someone who annoyed us. Love shows in actions.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not always feeling, 1 for choosing kindness, 1 for example, 1 for actions.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose good friends, avoid wrong places, be careful about what you watch, keep busy with good things, pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. (The wording "who art in heaven" is also accepted.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Strangers, harmful content, bullying, too much screen time, rumours, sharing private details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each danger up to 4.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each two correct names up to 3 marks.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing; joy: thanking God; peace: stopping quarrels; patience: waiting your turn; kindness: helping others; goodness: honesty; faithfulness: keeping promises; gentleness: speaking softly; self-control: walking away from a fight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with an example, up to 5.
